launcher.label: Help
launcher.tooltip: Show the tour for this screen

settings.title: Help and tours
settings.description: Short tours of the app's screens. Every one of them can be replayed as many times as you like.
settings.resetSuccess: The tours will be offered again.
settings.saveError: The tour state could not be saved.
settings.loadError: The tour state could not be loaded.

app-sidebar.title: App menu
app-sidebar.body: This is the way to every screen of the app and to settings. Collapse it when you need the width for a table.

app-help.title: This button
app-help.body: Every screen that has a tour keeps it in the same place. Come back to it whenever you want.

app-notifications.title: Notifications
app-notifications.body: Updates about your account and your team land here. The number on the bell counts the unread ones.

app-user-menu.title: Your account
app-user-menu.body: Profile, password, appearance and sign out. Two-factor authentication is turned on from here too.

dashboard-activity.title: Recent activity
dashboard-activity.body: What has happened in the organization lately, newest first.
